transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm really struggling with my eating habits because I keep losing control and eating massive amounts of food in a very short time. It's incredibly distressing, and this has been going on for over two years now. I just really need some help with it.
After these episodes of eating large amounts of food, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or the misuse of laxatives?

I don't force myself to throw up or use laxatives, but I do try to make up for it by fasting and completely skipping food for long periods afterward. I also force myself to do excessive exercise, pushing my body way past its physical limits to try and burn it all off.

latest_inference.note: Previously, both Binge-Eating Disorder and Bulimia Nervosa were considered. However, the patient's report of using compensatory behaviors—specifically excessive exercise and fasting following binge episodes—clinically distinguishes this from Binge-Eating Disorder and aligns with the criteria for Bulimia Nervosa.
